findings.claim: In TEST DATA Round 2, two of three answers explicitly distinguish discounted project value from annual expense or savings; the third recognizes a negative financial result but leaves the time boundary unstated.
Two of three TEST DATA change answers favor retaining an NPV sign/time explanation; one still prefers a carbon definition. These are fixture values, not observed improvement among real users.

payload.counterevidence: One fixture answer still prioritizes capture versus avoided CO2. Prompted text comprehension cannot establish unaided UI performance or eliminate the carbon-definition concern.

unresolved.question: Would the proposed short explanation improve an actual first-time user's unaided handoff in the real interface? This needs real, consented validation beyond the two-round offline exercise.

limitations: All answers and receipts are TEST DATA, with three usable answers per question in this round.
No participant actually saw a UI change; the prompt supplied a proposed text explanation and can induce learning or agreement.
The two-round cap is reached; remaining uncertainty must be reported rather than opening a third round.
